title: Data Engineering Manager
summary: Manages a team of data engineers who build and run the company's data platform: pipelines, the lakehouse or warehouse (central stores for analytics data), and governance. Sits between the data team and its users in analytics, data science, product and finance, and answers for data that is reliable, secure and affordable.
dailyDuties: Hold one-on-ones and coach data engineers
Review pipeline and data model designs
Check pipeline failures, data quality alerts and SLAs
Agree data priorities with analytics, product and finance teams
Review platform compute and storage spend

skills.expectation: Hire, coach and run reviews for a team of data engineers
Set platform architecture and engineering standards for the team
Agree data priorities and SLAs with analytics, product, finance and risk teams
Own reliable batch and streaming pipelines the business depends on
Review Spark jobs for correctness, scale and cost
Run a lakehouse or a cloud warehouse as the main analytics store
Run a lakehouse or a cloud warehouse as the main analytics store
Put lineage, catalogue, access control and stewardship in place
Set data quality rules, checks and alerts with clear owners
Track and cut compute and storage spend on the data platform
Run Airflow or a similar orchestrator at scale
Guide Kafka, Flink or Spark Streaming pipelines
Review dimensional and lakehouse data models
Forecast platform spend and track it against budget
Run interview loops and grow the team
Run planning and delivery for the team

groups.label: A lakehouse or cloud data warehouse

certifications.why: Shows data platform design on Google Cloud
Shows data management and governance depth
